query_contract.cohort_membership_rule: API query membership plus independent validation that every returned study has at least one protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions.type == DRUG

bundle_inventory.exclusion_reason: source manifest is self-referential and bound by manifest_sha256
bundle_inventory.included_artifacts: every regular file recursively below source root

query_contract.membership_semantics: Heuristic text-search cohort constrained to InterventionType=DRUG; false positives, ambiguous cardiac context, co-interventions, and unmapped drug names are retained.
query_contract.query.term: AREA[InterventionType]DRUG AND (QT OR QTc OR hERG OR "torsades de pointes" OR cardiotoxicity OR "cardiac repolarization")

semantic_and_rights_boundaries.citation: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2; record NCT ID, dataTimestamp, and retrieval date.
semantic_and_rights_boundaries.default_label_admission: prohibited_at_acquisition; no record or no posted results is absence, never a negative molecular efficacy, safety, cardiotoxicity, or activity outcome
semantic_and_rights_boundaries.evidence_admission: Registration, study-state, and posted-results are separate evidence states; molecule mappings require reviewed aliases and confidence.
semantic_and_rights_boundaries.license_boundary: Public registry records only; source attribution and disclaimer required.

terms_snapshot_content_status: SPA_shell_only_identical_to_api_documentation_HTML; terms text requires human browser or separate official static source review
